Brighton Defeats Manchester City, Manchester United Loses to Chelsea

Brighton secured their first away victory against Manchester City in their 18th attempt, winning 1-0. This result ended Manchester City's hopes of challenging for the title. In another match, a 10-man Manchester United was defeated by Chelsea.
